title: Cottage by the Sea | KEY.co
description_expanded: Step outside to discover the covered front porch, ideal for morning coffee or evening cocktails. The included golf cart allows you to explore the area effortlessly, whether you're heading to the beach or biking through charming local streets. With sleeping arrangements for up to ten guests, this home is perfect for family gatherings or group getaways. Experience the ultimate blend of coastal elegance and modern comfort in this stunning 30A beach house, where every detail is designed to create unforgettable memories. With a spacious living area and a fully equipped kitchen featuring a breakfast bar, this home offers the perfect setting for relaxation and entertainment. The master and second bedrooms boast king-sized beds, while the third bedroom has a queen bed and the fourth features a full-over-full bunk bed, ensuring ample space for everyone. Modern amenities include a full-size washer/dryer, free Wi-Fi, and a one-car garage, making your stay as comfortable as possible.
